R7AG-moose-backcountry-0004.name: 230 m N of Mesilinka River
R7AG-moose-backcountry-0004.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AG-moose-backcountry-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: 14 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 1.4 ha, 110 m SE.
Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: M.U.s 7-38 and 7-39. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 7-1/23.

plan: Drive: from Bear Lake, about 93 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.43039, -125.79078, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 8.2 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 157 m, about 180 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m W of the spot at 981 m (56.4077, -125.92127). Water: unnamed wetland 220 m SE (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-38, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AG-moose-backcountry-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-38: about 874 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.07 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
